findings.text: request['node']['write_paths'] = [SOURCE] is inert here. _live_claim_conflict builds the scope it compares from {**(record.get('node') or {}), 'write_paths': list(node.write_paths)} at reckon/crew/queue_edit.py:226-230, so the node argument's write paths overwrite the record's and _declared_scope_paths never reads the line the test just set. The line is copied from test_admission_admits_a_file_under_a_directory_claim, where the request record's own write_paths are what queue_admission._live_claim_hold reads and the line is required; here it suggests the record path is exercised when only the node argument is.

The recorded negative control does not falsify the assertion this commit adds. The node's declared negative control is 'revert the claim comparison to the dispatch base revision; the reproduced pair must then be held', but negative-control.log reverts tests/test_a_source_file_is_shared_by_default.py to f0a704370a and shows the superseded 'assert refusal is not None' failing at the landed code — a test that the old expectation was retired, not that 'assert refusal is None' reddens when queue_edit's comparison regresses. Combined with the test aborting at line 154 in both arms (after-suite.log), no recorded artefact shows this assertion green, or red on the production change it guards.

review_note: Reviewed head 1ca708f880f1b5ec80ad00b358c2be8e707412cc against base f0a704370ae97cde800d13f811fd63067c6d3764, the head the prior review read, covering only the commit gained since (1ca708f880, the run's sixth-to-last). The gain is a test-only repair of the prior review's blocking finding f7b63b24005: the queue-edit test that asserted a directory claim refuses a file under it now asserts admission and is renamed to state the landed behaviour, matching reckon/crew/queue_edit.py:262 which calls runs._claim_paths_share. By inspection the new assertion is a real guard and not vacuous: _scopes_overlap('pkg/source.py','pkg') is True at reckon/crew/runs.py:1295 and _claim_paths_share returns True for the pair under shared_roots ['pkg/'], so reverting the comparison to equality would make _live_claim_conflict return a ScopeConflict and redden 'assert refusal is None'. Two caveats keep durability below the guard's soundness: the assertion is never reached in either recorded arm because _dispatch raises CrewError at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:3436 (the changed test fails at tests/test_a_source_file_is_shared_by_default.py:154 in after-suite.log), and negative-control.log reverts the test file to f0a704370a and shows the OLD assertion failing rather than reverting the production comparison the node's declared negative control names, so no recorded artefact falsifies the new assertion. The suite delta is five ids by name only: five baseline ids retire as renames, both arms carry the same 12 backend-launch failures, and no test newly fails.
